body:
# Brokenstarsmp QoL Mixins

This project adds QoL (Quality of Life) mixins used on the [mc.palorderhosting.net](https://mc.palorderhosting.net) survival server.  
It is **recommended to install this mod on your client** when playing survival on `mc.palorderhosting.net`.  
These mixins also work in singleplayer.
